record: Status: Record - dated ADDENDUM to docs/audit/2026-11-03-least-privilege-audit.json, written 2026-11-18 for AZR-125. That audit is a dated record and is not edited; this file adds rows in the same shape. Its GET and PUT rows name the app KV document keys the 2026-11-03 rows omit: azure-onboarding-flow-last-seen (AZR-37, written by the background flow poll), azure-credential-lease and azure-credential-owner (the tenant session's, run-tenant-session.ts), tenant-cribl-mapping (the Setup tenant to Cribl mapping, found while pinning the others), and the two tenant-migration claim documents azure-coverage-selection-migrated and azure-onboarding-progress-migrated (tenantMigrationClaimKey(base) = {base}-migrated; loadTenantDocument reads and writes them when a tenant adopts a legacy unscoped document, and readStrandedLegacyDocument reads them; added in review round 1). No permission changes: every key is in the app's own KV namespace, which the platform grants every App user and which cannot be narrowed per key, exactly as the 2026-11-03 rows say. packages/core/src/domain/least-privilege/operations.ts cites both the dated row and the addendum row for cribl.kv.read and cribl.kv.write; operations.test.ts reads both files.

rows.path: /kvstore/{key} (app-scoped; addendum 2026-11-18) - azure-onboarding-flow-last-seen, azure-credential-lease, azure-credential-owner, tenant-cribl-mapping, azure-coverage-selection-migrated, azure-onboarding-progress-migrated
rows.operation: Cribl App Platform: App user access level on the installed app (platform grants /a/{appId}/kvstore/* through the AppUser role automatically; not declarable in policies.yml)
rows.leastBuiltInRole: App user (Apps > Installed > Share), the same grant as the 2026-11-03 GET /kvstore/{key} row
rows.narrowestScope: Cribl app (/a/{appId}/kvstore/*) within the one workspace; already the narrowest possible, cannot be narrowed per key
rows.citation: https://docs.cribl.io/apps/admin-guide/ (Sharing installed Apps; Who can run installed Apps)
functions: Azure onboarding flow poll - last-seen read (onboarding-flow/last-seen.ts)
Tenant session - credential lease and owner reads (usecases/tenant-session/run-tenant-session.ts)
Setup - tenant to Cribl mapping (tenant-cribl-mapping-section.tsx); Tenant gap scan

Azure onboarding - tenant migration claim reads for the coverage selection and onboarding progress (usecases/tenant-documents/tenant-documents.ts loadTenantDocument, readStrandedLegacyDocument); Tenant gap scan stranded-progress read
rows.notes: Read through the KvDocumentStore port (apps/cribl-app/src/platform/kv-document-store.ts), never encrypted. The guard that keeps the lists whole is packages/core/src/domain/least-privilege/kv-keys.test.ts, which derives the document keys from the @soc/core barrel's *_KEY constants. azure-coverage-selection and azure-onboarding-progress, named by the 2026-11-03 rows, are now also stored per tenant as {key}.{tenantId} (ADR 0009), and the one-time adoption of the legacy unscoped document records which tenant took it in {key}-migrated (tenantMigrationClaimKey; named in this row); the same grant covers them.
